messages:
Nina K: Demo flopped — onboarding sample hit three different error shapes across SDKs. Node returned {error_code: 'auth'}, android returned plain text, python raised RuntimeError. UI expects `.status`.

Omar R: Noted. We need a canonical envelope and typed exceptions. Minimal keys: code (string), status (int), message (string), retryable (bool), retry_after (secs optional), docs (url).

Jules B: Agree. Example we can paste: ```json
{
  "error":{
    "code":"rate_limit_exceeded",
    "status":429,
    "message":"Too many requests",
    "retryable":true,
    "retry_after":30,
    "docs":"https://docs.redwood.ai/errors#rate_limit_exceeded"
  }
}
```

Omar R: Mapping rules: 5xx -> TransientError (retryable), 429 -> RateLimitError (retry_after if header present), 401/403 -> AuthError (non-retryable by default, but allow `can_refresh=true`). Fallback: if envelope exists, honor `retryable`.

Nina K: I'll add integration checks to the sample app to assert typed exceptions expose `.code`, `.status`, `.retryable`. ETA 48h.

DevEx Bot: Reminder: link /templates/error-spec.md in PRs.

Jules B: I'll update node & python SDKs to emit Error subclasses and include telemetry tag `error.code`.

Omar R: I'll handle Android safe accessors in the sample UI and show docs link when present.

Nina K: Assigning reviewers in the PRs: @Jules B @Omar R. Thanks — let's avoid more demo surprises.
